title: Probation services fee; assessment.
bodyText: Any defendant received for supervision pursuant to chapter 353B shall be assessed a probation services fee pursuant to section 706-648.
bodyHtml: §353-34  Probation services fee; assessment.  Any defendant received for supervision pursuant to chapter 353B shall be assessed a probation services fee pursuant to section 706-648. [L 2000, c 205, §1; am L 2004, c 78, §1]
